name: Automaise (Automaise S.A.)
basis: Automaise (Automaise S.A.)'s own public pages and, for company basics only, the news sources named beside each fact
what: Automaise sells a set of three AI agents for customer service teams: a voice and chat assistant, a copilot for human agents, and back-office workflow automation.

facts.fact: Founded in 2017 by Ernesto Pedrosa and Carlos Oliveira (investor note).
facts.span: Since its founding in 2017 by Ernesto Pedrosa and Carlos Oliveira
Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Braga (Portugal)

facts.fact: Raised a EUR 5 million Series A in March 2025, led by Oxy Capital.
facts.span: a significant boost with a €5 million Series A funding round

facts.fact: The company describes three agents built to work together.
facts.span: Three AI Agents. One ecosystem. Built to work together.

facts.fact: The about page lists offices in Braga, Lisbon, Madrid and Barcelona.
The trust centre lists ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC2 Type 2.
The trust centre says Automaise acts as a data processor for its customers.
facts.span: Automaise processes data on behalf of its customers, acting as a data processor.

facts.fact: Automaise S.A. was a beneficiary of the Center for Responsible AI agenda (PRR), with a stated investment of EUR 2,628,142.
In 2023 Automaise announced its own customer-service LLM, Quokka, hosted on its own servers.
facts.span: With our Large Language Model hosted on our own servers

facts.fact: Jornal Economico (1 July 2026) reports a Portugal 2030-backed project, the Automaise Sustainable AI Platform.
facts.span: está a desenvolver o projeto “Automaise Sustainable AI Platform”

people.name: Fábio Pinto
people.role: Head of AI (as named in a July 2023 company blog post)

solutions.name: Conversational AI
solutions.what: Voice and chat assistant (inbound and outbound voice, customer self-service chat, internal helpdesk chat) that answers customers and completes transactions such as data changes, payments and orders.

solutions.name: AI Workflows
solutions.what: Back-office automation of multi-step processes (data changes, payments, claims) across CRM, ERP and APIs, with a no-code workflow builder.

solutions.name: Agent Assist
solutions.what: Copilot for human agents that follows live voice and chat interactions and puts suggested answers and next steps on the agent's screen.

stories.what: Conversational AI chat assistant that resolves account access issues (password recovery, account unblocking, new passwords); 93% automation rate of webchat interactions.
stories.span: able to manage and autonomously solve account access related issues

stories.what: Conversational AI chat assistant integrated with the CRM; customers can manage orders and a cart and schedule delivery and service requests.
stories.span: manage orders and a live shopping cart; schedule delivery and service requests

stories.what: Conversational AI internal helpdesk assistant that triages, tags and closes support tickets; 32% deflection within 3 weeks.
stories.span: autonomously, close a wide range of support tickets.

stories.what: Conversational AI assistant for policyholders that executes service requests; 84% self-service rate.
stories.span: but also to execute advanced service requests.

stories.what: Agent Assist ticket workflow in Salesforce that classifies, routes and closes tickets; 35% closed without human intervention.
stories.span: classify, distribute, prioritize and close a wide range of diverse tickets.

stories.what: AI Workflows automation of medical claim approvals; 58% of claims fully automated.
